g.text: Figure 2 · Sustained competition and global activity polarity
Continued review sheet 2 of 2 · full support 3; 1000 on, 13,000 off; native peaks WP 0.1 / G 6.4 / H 1
D Complete local-pattern context at t = 14,000
1→2 changes size/material/architecture/routes and cue angle (144°→108°). Only 2→3 moves the cue in the identical full basal state (108°→144°).
Holmes peak 1; cue off at 1000. Native histories show 0–4000; map endpoints are at 14,000. Gray lies outside C30; old peak remains intact at the periodic cut.
P = M₁(t)/M₁(0): initial (1,0); magnitude may exceed 1. Squares: cue off; triangles: t = 4000.
Near-zero resultant need not mean inactivity: antipodal Holmes retains two sites and nearly unchanged total Rac. See the linked full-grid/vector evidence.
Single peak near old; identity unresolved
